newsitem.title: USA: American Business to take Q3 charge.
newsitem.headline: American Business to take Q3 charge.

text.p: American Business Information Inc said Tuesday it acquired the assets of Digital Directory Assistance Inc for about $17 million, a transaction that will result in a one-time after-tax charge of about $6.3 million in the third quarter.
The charge will represent purchased research and development. It said the remaining intangibles are expected to be amortized over a period of three to seven years.
It said the acquisition is not expected to be dilutive to fourth-quarter 1996 earnings.
Digital Directory publishes PhoneDisc CD-ROM products such as PhoneDisc Powerfinder, Powerfinder Pro and U.S. Homes & Businesses on CD-ROM.
Digital Directory's revenues for the 12 months ended July 31 were more than $8 million.
Chairman Vinod Gupta said the acquisition strategically positions American Business Information to aggressively pursue consumer demand for business and consumer database products on CD-ROM.
